title: 10 Rhodes Wedding Venues From Lindos to the Old Town
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW venue guide. Model: content/posts/mykonos-wedding-venues and content/posts/santorini-wedding-venues. INCLUSION RULE: a live read of the venue's own official site says it hosts weddings. Never snippets alone. If fewer than 10 qualify, the title count changes and the person is told; no padding. Hold non-luxury venues as reserves. The title promises Lindos to the Old Town: include Lindos venues and at least one Old Town (medieval town) venue if any qualify. Public monuments are named only as settings, as an official source describes them; civil ceremony locations go in the legal section, not the count.

Areas: Lindos and the south-east (St Paul's Bay, Vlicha, Pefkos); the Old Town and Rhodes city; the east coast (Kallithea, Faliraki, Kolymbia, Tsambika); the west coast (Ixia, Ialysos, Kalavarda). Each entry: setting, ceremony options as stated, capacity, rooms and exclusive use where published (else 'Not published'), one standout. One Advisor line in the whole body (comparison section) plus the close.

Supporting sections: at-a-glance table (5 columns, mobile-friendly); how to compare like for like; choosing an area; getting there (Rhodes airport and port from official sources; Smartraveller ferry advice only; no transfers); when to marry (HNMS Rodos station, labelled; Smartraveller heat, wildfire, swimming; no best month); legal in brief (as at November 2026; Embassy Athens and Smartraveller; Municipality of Rhodes civil steps only if an official page is read live, else 'check with the municipality and the embassy, including any fees'; link the Greece venues guide's legal section).

OVERLAP: SEO checks rankings for rhodes wedding venues and variants (rhodes wedding, lindos wedding venues, getting married in rhodes, rhodes old town wedding, st pauls bay wedding). Link /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues, /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages-all-inclusive, /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages, /destinations/europe/greece, /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions (once).

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk; 'often told' at most once; no hedge stacking; link each source once; no 'best' or ranking; no best month.

Sources: venues' official sites; official sources for practical facts (HNMS, airport operator, Visit Greece, Municipality of Rhodes, Smartraveller, Embassy). Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking or review sites, Wikipedia.

UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=rhodes-wedding-venues&utm_content=primary|secondary|magnet|closing on /wonderland-concierge and /magazine only. Anchor text names 'Wedded Concierge', never 'Wonderland Concierge'.

Speed: Apify web-fetch. 4 parallel batches (A Lindos and south-east fact_01+; B Old Town and Rhodes city fact_100+; C east and west coasts fact_200+; D practical and legal fact_300+), 15 min HARD, reads in one parallel round, scratch folders rh_a..rh_d; top-up rh_e (fact_400+) early if short; never retry a declined call.
Images: placeholders only; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding.

Do not use 'last dance' (brand-facts.md still contains it; never reuse that line); Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges; no 'free'.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed, no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
